title: How to build kids’ ‘cognitive endurance’ in an age of distraction

paragraphs.english: This page is an independently written reading guide to an article by Heather Schofield and Supreet Kaur in Scientific American, first published online on 10 June 2026. The publisher’s full text is available at the link below.
paragraphs.chinese: 本页是为 Heather Schofield 与 Supreet Kaur 发表在《科学美国人》上的一篇文章独立撰写的阅读导读。该文于2026年6月10日首次在线发布，全文请通过下方原文链接阅读。

paragraphs.english: The piece opens with a scene most readers will recognise. Halfway through a difficult exam, attention begins to slide: the words on the page blur, and the mind drifts towards what to have for dinner. The authors’ point is that this is not a failure of character. It is a window into how minds behave under sustained demand.
paragraphs.chinese: 文章从一个多数读者都熟悉的场景写起：考试进行到一半，注意力开始滑走，纸上的字模糊起来，脑子飘到晚饭吃什么。作者想说明的是，这并不是性格上的失败，而是心智在持续消耗之下如何运作的一扇窗口。

paragraphs.english: Both writers are behavioural scientists who study how economic circumstances shape thinking, and the article is built around a term they want readers to take seriously: cognitive endurance. The phrase is deliberately physical. Just as a runner slows over a long race, almost everyone performs worse on a task the longer they keep at it.
paragraphs.chinese: 两位作者都是研究经济环境如何塑造思维的行为科学家，全文围绕一个他们希望读者认真对待的说法展开：认知耐力（cognitive endurance）。这个词是刻意借自身体经验的。就像跑者在长距离比赛中会慢下来，几乎所有人在同一件事上做得越久，表现就越差。

paragraphs.english: That claim rests on a study of more than 1,600 children, and the pattern held almost everywhere the researchers looked: scores fell as time on task grew. What varied was the steepness of the fall.
paragraphs.chinese: 这一判断来自一项对1600多名儿童的研究，而且在研究者观察到的几乎所有群体中都成立：随着任务时间变长，成绩都在下降。真正有差别的是下降的陡峭程度。

paragraphs.english: The variation is where the argument turns social. Children in poor countries declined about three times as fast as children in wealthy ones, and students from disadvantaged backgrounds slipped more quickly than better-off peers. The authors then describe what those school days actually contained. In wealthier schools, children were more often left to work through problems alone, to read silently, or to concentrate on a single task; in poorer ones, much of the day went on listening to lectures, memorising by rote and copying from the board.
paragraphs.chinese: 差别所在，正是论证转向社会层面的地方。穷国儿童的下降速度约为富国儿童的三倍，家庭条件不利的学生也比条件较好的同龄人滑落得更快。接着，作者描述了这些孩子的在校时间究竟由什么构成：在较富裕的学校，孩子更多被放手独自做题、安静阅读或专注于单一任务；在较贫困的学校，一天中大量时间用于听讲、死记硬背和抄板书。

paragraphs.english: That contrast suggested a hypothesis: the school day itself, and the amount of sustained effort it demands, may be training the capacity in question — or failing to train it.
paragraphs.chinese: 这种对比提示了一个假设：学校的一天本身，以及它对持续用力的要求有多高，可能正在训练这种能力——也可能恰恰没能训练它。

paragraphs.english: To test the idea, the researchers ran an experiment with 1,636 elementary school students in India. Study-hall periods were assigned to one of three conditions. The control group carried on as usual, copying a few maths problems from the board and then filling the rest of the time as they wished, which required very little continuous effort.
paragraphs.chinese: 为检验这一想法，研究者在印度开展了一项实验，参与者是1636名小学生。自习时段被分配到三种条件之一。对照组照常进行：从黑板上抄几道数学题，剩下的时间自由安排，几乎不需要持续用力。

paragraphs.english: The two treatment groups spent twenty minutes of the same period on unbroken cognitive work. One solved maths problems on tablets, in an application that adapted to each child’s level but deliberately offered no game-like rewards. The other played demanding games — mazes and tangrams — with no academic content at all, also calibrated to keep them challenged.
paragraphs.chinese: 两个实验组则在同一时段里用二十分钟做不间断的认知工作。一组在平板上做数学题，所用程序会按每个孩子的水平调整难度，但刻意不加入游戏化的奖励；另一组玩有难度的游戏——走迷宫和七巧板——完全不含学科内容，难度同样被调整到让孩子保持吃力。

paragraphs.english: Both groups improved, and by almost the same amount. On tests of listening comprehension, reasoning and maths, performance declined about 22 per cent more slowly than in the control group. Whether the practice was mathematical or not made little difference, which supports the authors’ reading: the act of concentrating mattered more than the subject being concentrated on.
paragraphs.chinese: 两组都有进步，幅度几乎一样。在听力理解、推理和数学测试中，他们的成绩随测试推进而下滑的速度比对照组慢约22%。练习的内容是不是数学，差别很小，这支持了作者的解读：专注这个动作本身，比专注在什么科目上更重要。

paragraphs.english: The gains appeared on other measures as well. Treated students did better on standard tests of sustained attention, such as spotting a target symbol in a grid; their teachers reported less fidgeting and better follow-through on multi-step instructions; and their grades in Hindi, English and maths were roughly 0.09 standard deviations higher.
paragraphs.chinese: 收益也出现在其他指标上：实验组学生在测量持续注意力的标准测验中表现更好，比如在网格中找出目标符号；老师报告他们更少坐立不安，更能把多步骤的指令执行到底；他们的印地语、英语和数学成绩大约高出0.09个标准差。

paragraphs.english: To give that figure a scale, the authors compare it with a well-known intervention: placing a pupil in a class with seven fewer students per teacher. The cognitive-training effect was between half and three quarters as large — for twenty to fifty minutes a week over six months.
paragraphs.chinese: 为了给这个数字一个尺度，作者把它与一项众所周知的干预相比：把学生放进每名教师少七名学生的班级。认知训练的效应量相当于后者的二分之一到四分之三——而训练只是每周二十到五十分钟、持续半年。

paragraphs.english: The article then leaves the classroom. In related work, data-entry workers made more mistakes as their shifts wore on, and the decline was steeper for those with less education. Voting shows something similar: when a proposition appears further down a long ballot in California, voters are more likely to leave the default option in place, and the effect is strongest in lower-income neighbourhoods.
paragraphs.chinese: 文章随后走出教室。在相关研究中，数据录入员随着班次推进出错更多，受教育程度较低者的下滑明显更陡。投票也呈现类似情形：在加州，当某条议案排在长选票的靠后位置时，选民更可能保留默认选项，而这种效应在低收入社区最强。

paragraphs.english: The implication is uncomfortable. If the ability to keep thinking hard is partly built through practice, and if access to that practice is unevenly distributed, then a gap that opens at school may widen for decades. Endurance becomes one more channel through which early disadvantage compounds.
paragraphs.chinese: 其中的含义令人不安。如果持续用脑的能力有一部分是靠练习建立起来的，而获得这种练习的机会分配不均，那么在学校阶段拉开的差距可能持续扩大几十年。耐力于是成为早年劣势不断累积的又一条通道。

paragraphs.english: The authors are careful about what they have not settled. They do not know which form of training works best, and they note that the experiment measured short-run gains in one setting. Their practical suggestion is broad rather than prescriptive: puzzles, a musical instrument, certain video games — anything that demands sustained, deliberate and self-directed effort.
paragraphs.chinese: 作者对尚未解决的问题很谨慎。他们并不知道哪种训练方式最好，也指出这项实验测量的是特定环境下的短期收益。他们给出的实践建议宽泛而不教条：拼图、一件乐器、某些电子游戏——任何要求持续、刻意且自主用力的活动。

paragraphs.english: What stays with the reader is the framing. Attention is treated here less as a fixed gift than as stamina, something that can be spent, trained and exhausted; the closing lines insist that the capacity is not fixed.
paragraphs.chinese: 留给读者的是那个框架本身。在这里，注意力与其说是天赋，不如说是体力：会被消耗、可以被训练，也会被耗尽；文章结尾几行坚持认为，这种能力并非固定不变。

paragraphs.english: Here is an editor-written practice sentence, not a quotation from the original article: Because the study rewarded nothing but persistence, its results suggest that what children practise may matter less than the habit of staying with a task until it is finished.
paragraphs.chinese: 以下是编辑撰写的练习句，并非原文引句：由于这项研究只奖励坚持本身，其结果提示，孩子们练什么或许不如“把一件事做到底”的习惯重要。

paragraphs.english: As you read, keep the study and the argument apart. The experiment was randomised and the outcome measured, so the causal claim about practice is stronger than the correlational claims about schools and countries; notice the hedged verbs — “may”, “seems”, “suggest” — and the comparison with class size, which is offered as a yardstick rather than as proof that the two are equivalent.
paragraphs.chinese: 阅读时请把实验与论证分开看。实验是随机分组的，结果也被测量过，因此关于练习的因果判断，比关于学校与国家的相关性判断更有力；同时注意那些留有余地的动词——“may”“seems”“suggest”——以及与班级规模的比较，它是用来提供参照尺度的，而不是用来证明两者等价。

sentenceNotes.sentence: Just as a runner slows over a long race, almost everyone performs worse on a task the longer they keep at it.
sentenceNotes.mainClause: 主句为 almost everyone performs worse on a task，主语 everyone，谓语 performs，表语 worse，on a task 说明在什么方面；前面 Just as 引导比较状语从句。
sentenceNotes.structure: Just as a runner slows over a long race 是方式/比较状语从句，just as 意为“正如”；主句后 the longer they keep at it 是 the more..., the more... 结构的省略形式，相当于 the longer they keep at it, the worse they perform，比较结果已并入前面的 worse。
sentenceNotes.translation: 正如跑者在长距离比赛中会慢下来，几乎所有人在同一件事上做得越久，表现就越差。
sentenceNotes.tip: just as 在此不是“刚刚”而是“正如”，引出类比；keep at it 意为“坚持做下去”，it 指前面那件事；注意 the longer... 放在句末仍表“越……就越……”，不要误读成时间状语。

sentenceNotes.sentence: Whether the practice was mathematical or not made little difference, which supports the authors’ reading: the act of concentrating mattered more than the subject being concentrated on.
sentenceNotes.mainClause: 主句主干为 Whether the practice was mathematical or not made little difference，主语是一个 whether 引导的名词性从句，谓语 made，宾语 little difference。
sentenceNotes.structure: which supports the authors’ reading 是非限制性定语从句，which 指代前面整个主句的内容；冒号后 the act of concentrating mattered more than the subject being concentrated on 用来具体说明 reading（解读）的内容，其中 being concentrated on 是现在分词被动式作后置定语修饰 subject。
sentenceNotes.translation: 练习的内容是不是数学，差别很小，这支持了作者的解读：专注这个动作本身，比专注在什么科目上更重要。
sentenceNotes.tip: whether... or not 从句整体作主语时谓语用单数（made）；make little difference 意为“几乎没有影响”，difference 前不加冠词；the subject being concentrated on 中 on 的宾语是省略的关系代词，指 the subject，介词不能丢。

sentenceNotes.sentence: Because the study rewarded nothing but persistence, its results suggest that what children practise may matter less than the habit of staying with a task until it is finished.
sentenceNotes.mainClause: 主句为 its results suggest that...，主语 results，谓语 suggest，that 引导宾语从句；宾语从句的主干是 what children practise may matter less than the habit。
sentenceNotes.structure: Because the study rewarded nothing but persistence 是原因状语从句；宾语从句中 what children practise 是主语从句作 matter 的主语，may matter less than 构成比较结构，比较对象是 the habit of staying with a task until it is finished，其中 of staying... 作 habit 的同位说明，until 从句表示持续到何时。
sentenceNotes.translation: 由于这项研究只奖励坚持本身，其结果提示，孩子们练什么或许不如“把一件事做到底”的习惯重要。
sentenceNotes.tip: 本句为编辑自拟练习句，不是原刊引文。nothing but 意为“只有、只不过”，不是“什么都没有”；what 引导主语从句时不能用 that 替换；matter 在此是不及物动词，意为“要紧、有影响”，不要当作名词“事情”。
